description: Schema for cardioEnrich extraction benchmark records — IDENTICAL structure and metrics to pxEnrich tests/benchmark/benchmark_schema.json; only the field list is the cardio set. The student-curated expert benchmark drops into benchmark_records.jsonl in this format; example_records.jsonl shows the shape with examples derived from the demo seed (NOT an expert benchmark).

record_format.accession: ProteomeXchange accession (or labeled CARDIO-DEMO-* synthetic id) the expectation applies to
record_format.field: one of: disease_context | hf_subtype | donor_status | etiology | cardiac_region | sample_type | organism_context | model_system | cell_state_context | sex_context | perturbation_context
record_format.expected_status: asserted | unknown | mixed | conflicting | abstained | not_evaluable
record_format.expected_value: expected value when status is asserted/mixed; null otherwise
record_format.value_match: exact | contains  (how expected_value is compared; default contains)
record_format.rationale: curator's note on why this is the correct answer
record_format.set: regression | holdout  (holdout records are EXCLUDED from development runs and only scored at final evaluation — freeze them before tuning rules)

metrics.accuracy: fraction of records where status and (when applicable) value match
metrics.false_assertion_rate: expected non-asserted (unknown/abstained/conflicting/mixed) but system asserted a value — the most serious error class; CI exits non-zero if > 0
metrics.missed_value_rate: expected asserted but system returned unknown/abstained
metrics.correct_abstention_rate: of records where abstention was expected, fraction where the system abstained
metrics.scope_error_rate: status matched but value or scope wrong (e.g. study_focus treated as cohort status)
